source: Team demo content, not medical advice; needs flight-surgeon review

questions.text: Can they speak in full sentences?
questions.textSelf: Can you speak in full sentences?

questions.text: Are the lips or face turning blue?
questions.textSelf: Are your lips or face turning blue? Ask a crew member to look.

questions.text: Is the suit or air supply working?

answers.label: No, there is a suit or oxygen problem

questions.text: Do others nearby have a headache or trouble breathing too?

summary.LOW: Breathing is a bit hard but they can talk. Help them rest.
summary.MODERATE: Breathing is clearly hard. Give oxygen and watch closely.
summary.CRITICAL: Breathing is failing. Act now and alert the base.

summarySelf.LOW: Breathing is a bit hard but you can talk. Sit and rest.

LOW.text: Help them sit upright and rest.
Breathe slowly with them: in 4, out 4.

MODERATE.text: Give oxygen from the emergency kit.
MODERATE.textSelf: Take oxygen from the emergency kit.

MODERATE.text: Check the suit and the air supply.
Check the oxygen level again in 2 minutes.
Alert the base if no better in 10 min.

CRITICAL.text: Move them to a safe area if needed.
CRITICAL.textSelf: Move to a safe area if needed.

CRITICAL.text: Move everyone out of bad cabin air.
Give oxygen from the emergency kit now.
CRITICAL.textSelf: Take oxygen from the emergency kit now.

CRITICAL.text: Sit them up, or on their side if asleep.
CRITICAL.textSelf: Sit up. Call a crew member.

CRITICAL.text: Stay with them and watch their breathing.
CRITICAL.textSelf: Do not stay alone while breathing is hard.

callBaseWhen: Call the base if lips turn blue or they cannot speak.
callBaseWhenSelf: Call the base if your lips turn blue or you cannot speak.
